result.fix: Run `firewall-cmd --list-all --zone=public` and check that 6443/tcp and 10250/tcp are accepted from the nodes that need them. If not, run `firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --add-port=6443/tcp --add-port=10250/tcp && firewall-cmd --reload`.
result.message: Cannot confirm 6443/tcp and 10250/tcp in firewalld zone public: /etc/firewalld/direct.xml holds direct rules, which rdy does not evaluate.
notes: firewalld policies, direct rules added only at runtime and rules written outside firewalld are not read
